Title: Ukraine and Russia's asymmetric war of attrition
Description: Kyiv and Moscow have stepped up attacks on each other's infrastructure in recent weeks, aiming to weaken the opposing economy and undermine morale. Ukraine has paid a heavier price because it does not possess ballistic missiles and finds it increasingly difficult to intercept those targeting its territory.

Title: JD Vance delivers convoluted speech to US Republican Jewish organization

Title: 'With France seeking profound change, momentum lies only with candidates who promise to upend the status quo'
Description: As speculation mounts over a possible second-round duel between far-right Marine Le Pen and radical left Jean-Luc Mélenchon in the 2027 French presidential election, no candidate from a party that has previously governed has managed to break through. This situation is having damaging effects, writes Le Monde columnist Françoise Fressoz.
